runs.title: This UK AI grant is open to individuals — through a research host.
runs.summary: Added UKRI’s sustainable-AI opportunity with its individual-but-hosted eligibility gate, deadline, maximum project cost, and 80% funding rule.

runs.title: MongoDB startup credits are direct. The number is not public.
runs.summary: Added MongoDB’s direct early-stage route and separated its visible company-profile and 12-month clocks from its unpublished base-tier credit amount.

runs.title: AWS’s USD 1,000 startup credit has a website gate. Its USD 200,000 route needs a provider ID.
runs.summary: Added AWS’s explicit public-website gate and 5–10-business-day application decision window, while separating both from credit validity and the partner-gated Portfolio route.

runs.title: Azure’s USD 1,000 startup credit has a 90-day clock. The student route does not.
runs.summary: Added separate Azure student and startup rows so eligibility, expiry, and post-credit consequences sit beside each amount.

runs.title: Vercel’s USD 30,000 headline only matters if your partner can prove the route
runs.summary: Added Vercel for Startups as a funded, partner-gated route and put its proof, expiry, AI Gateway cap, and post-credit billing alongside the amount.

runs.title: One individual grant is finally on the board. The Start-tier amount is too.
runs.summary: Added NLnet's dated open-technology grant for individual applicants, verified Google Start at USD 2,000 for 12 months, and preserved Cloudflare's unresolved self-funded and recent-funding wording.

runs.title: The number that matters is the tier you can reach
runs.summary: Initial source-verified catalogue for individual cloud credits and startup programmes, with partner gates and unknowns made visible.
